title: TypeScript Examples
description: Copy-ready TypeScript snippets for everyday patterns: typed functions, interfaces, discriminated unions, generics, classes, utility types, async code, tuples, as const and declaration files. Run them locally with npx tsx.

examples.title: Typed function with default parameters
examples.description: Two small functions with annotated parameters, default values and a guarded range check; the pattern for most utility code.

examples.title: Interface with optional and readonly properties
examples.description: An interface describing a book, with a readonly identifier and an optional year handled through the nullish coalescing operator.
examples.output:
Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs by Abelson & Sussman (1996, 657 pages)
Untitled by Anonymous (unknown year, 12 pages)

examples.title: Discriminated union with an exhaustive switch
examples.description: Three payment shapes share a method discriminant; the switch narrows each case and the never check guarantees no shape is forgotten.

examples.title: Generic groupBy
examples.description: A generic function that groups any array by a key callback and returns a Partial Record, so every lookup is typed as possibly missing.

examples.title: Class with a private field, accessors and a static factory
examples.description: A value class that validates its state in the constructor, exposes getters and a setter, and offers a static alternative constructor.

examples.title: API DTOs derived with Omit, Pick and Partial
examples.description: One User interface, three derived types for creating, updating and exposing users, and functions that keep the password hash out of the public shape.

examples.title: Type-safe event emitter
examples.description: A generic emitter whose event names and listener arguments come from a single event map, so a wrong event name or argument type is a compile error.
examples.output:
user 7 logged in at 09:30
logged out

examples.title: Typed fetch with a Result union and runtime validation
examples.description: A generic fetchJson that never throws: it returns an ok or error object, validates the body with a type predicate and narrows caught errors.

examples.title: Returning several values with labelled tuples
examples.description: Functions that return labelled tuples, destructured by the caller with full type information, including a tuple-or-undefined result for empty input.
examples.output:
Grace | Brewster Hopper
from 2 to 9
undefined

examples.title: as const route map and satisfies
examples.description: A route table declared once with as const, with the route names and paths derived as literal unions, plus satisfies for a validated theme object.

examples.title: Reusable isDefined type predicate
examples.description: A generic predicate that removes null and undefined from a list, giving filter a precise element type without a cast.

examples.title: Declaration file for an untyped package
examples.description: A types/tiny-slug.d.ts file that describes an imaginary JavaScript-only package, followed by the code that uses it with full type checking.
